● I'll add the tmux driver behind the same interface the Herdr
  driver already uses, then wire it into the registry.

● Read(internal/driver/herdr.go)
  ⎿  Read 142 lines (ctrl+o to expand)

● The interface is four methods: Panes, Read, Send, Submit. tmux
  covers all four with capture-pane and send-keys. The capture
  call needs -e so escapes survive; without them the faint-span
  trick cannot tell a ghost suggestion from typed input.

● Update(internal/driver/tmux.go)
  ⎿  Updated internal/driver/tmux.go with 34 additions and 2
     removals

       12 +  // escape sequences included.
       13 +  func (d *Tmux) capturePane(
       14 +    id string, n int,
       15 +  ) (string, error) {
       16 +    out, err := exec.Command(
       17 +      "tmux", "capture-pane", "-p", "-e",
       18 +      "-S", "-"+strconv.Itoa(n), "-t", id,
       19 +    ).Output()
       20 +    if err != nil {
       21 +      return "", fmt.Errorf("capture-pane %s: %w", id, err)
       22 +    }
       23 +
       24 +    return string(out), nil
       25 +  }
